answer: A head locks jade at entry and earns weight as jade×2^g, g counting its own attested garden seasons — judged tasks only it answered, each judge signing a fresh echo that no other head may co-sign. Weight cannot be bought, lent or split; it doubles only per season served. To match one honest agent, each of k clones must serve its own full g seasons — k×g in total, no capital compresses them — and a proven fake forfeits its jade to its finders. An honest newcomer pays plain jade and waits one season.
